content.title: EVGO Q3 CY2025 Deep Dive: Revenue Growth Driven by Network Expansion and Operational Leverage
content.summary: Electric vehicle charging company EVgo (NASDAQ:EVGO) beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 36.7% year on year to $92.3 million.
